source.prompt: (the raven's) A common raven (Corvus corax), one adult standing on flat ground, side-on neutral pose. Wings folded tight and flat against the flanks, folded primaries reaching nearly to the tail tip; body slim, about one third as wide as long. Heavy deep black bill about as long as the head, strongly curved culmen, a tuft of bristle feathers covering the nostrils on the base of the upper bill. Shaggy, pointed, bearded throat hackles. Flat crown sloping straight into the bill (Roman-nose profile), thick neck. Long graduated wedge-shaped tail, central feathers longest, pointed tip, no notch. Black scaled legs, four toes: three forward, one back, flat on the ground. All-black glossy plumage with visible feather edges. No base, no perch, no rock. Realistic, game-ready, closed, symmetric. Refine: Common raven, all-black plumage with a subtle blue-violet gloss on the back, scapulars and folded wings, each feather edge a slightly lighter black so the feather tracts read; matte black bill and nasal bristles, matte black scaled legs and toes, dark brown eye. Even, flat, unlit albedo: no baked shadows, no highlights, no ambient occlusion.

rig: The bird template's ground variant, exactly as client/assets/raven_ground.glb (tools/build_raven_ground.py, RIG_GROUND: folded wings that flick, head yaw, hop) and to be loaded with its loader constants scaled: BODY 0, LEG_A 1 (left leg), LEG_B 2 (right), TAIL 3, WING_L/R 4/5 (folded wing, pivot at the shoulder), HEAD 6 (head and neck, pivot at the base of the neck), HAND_L/R 9/10 (folded primaries, pivot at the wrist). extras.rig keys as the raven's: kind, length_m, folded_wings, parts, wing, wrist, head, tail, hip_l, hip_r, note. extras.ground holds the RAVEN_GROUND-like points: bodyY 0.1568, head [0, 0.178, 0.1195] (the HEAD pivot), bill [0, 0.1861, 0.2237] (the bill tip). No skin.
accuracy_notes: Reads as a crow beside the raven: smaller (0.44 m), a smaller, straighter, shallower bill (0.85x long, 0.75x deep about its axis, the decurved tip straightened), a smooth throat (no hackles), a smaller head with the crown domed a little, and a squarish, slightly rounded tail tip in place of the wedge; all black with a faint blue-purple gloss on the mantle, scapulars and folded wings, black bill and legs, dark eye (the raven's graded texture, the gloss tinted a little more purple). Still the raven's body: scaled to 0.44 m bill to tail after the bill and tail edits, its body is about 0.75x the raven's, so a little stout for a 0.45 kg crow (a uniform 0.71x would match the mass); the crown is still flatter than a crow's; the nasal bristles are the raven's (smaller with the bill); the hips sit 3.3 cm apart fore and aft, left from the source's stride; the source's folded wingtips reach most of the way down the tail. The squared tail tip is subtle in the side view; the raven mesh's tail was narrow from above to begin with.
